Friendzy / Classic party games / Name That Tune

How to play Name That Tune

Hum it. Guess it. Win it. Players take turns humming or beatboxing a song while others race to identify it. First correct guess earns a point. No lyrics allowed — just the melody.

2–10 players~10 minMusical & EnergeticMemory & chain games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. One player thinks of a well-known song.
  2. They hum, whistle, or beat out the melody — no words allowed.
  3. Others shout out guesses as fast as they can.
  4. First person to guess correctly earns a point.
  5. Set a 30-second limit per song. If nobody guesses, hummer scores a point.

Example round

  • Someone hums the 'Friends' theme. Six people shout 'FRIENDS!' simultaneously.
  • Someone hums an obscure 2009 hit. Blank stares. Hummer wins.
  • 'Is that Taylor Swift?' 'That's literally the Mario theme.' 'SAME ENERGY.'

Tips

  • Pick songs everyone knows — it's more fun when people are close.
  • Exaggerate the rhythmic parts of the melody to make it recognizable.
